ISMS GRC Platform | ISO 27001 Internal Audit, Risk and Remediation Management

Built a centralised ISMS GRC platform to manage ISO 27001 internal audit findings, risk management and IT remediation through one dashboard, bringing control assessments, risk ratings, corrective actions and remediation status into a single place for review.
Connected the compliance lifecycle from ISO control assessment to finding, risk rating, corrective action, ITSM ticket, SLA tracking and final resolution.
Built end-to-end traceability so each issue can be followed from the ISO control where it was raised through the related risk, assigned corrective action, remediation and formal closure.
Modelled risk ratings, corrective action ownership and SLA-based due dates for each finding, making overdue remediation visible and helping users review pending actions and follow up on closure.
